verdict.rationale: Zep's Graphiti-based Context Graph explicitly supports bi-temporal modeling and 'fact invalidation' to reconcile contradictory information over time, and docs describe edge/node deletion plus incremental thread summary updates as mechanisms for superseding stale memory. Community commentary from the Zep team also confirms this was a deliberate design response to earlier hallucination/recall problems with naive fact extraction. missing for 10: no first-party doc walking through a concrete contradiction-resolution example, no independent benchmark validating merge/supersede accuracy, and no detail on conflict-resolution logic when multiple sources disagree simultaneously.
